subject: Decision brief: Meeting room selection + AV/interop checklist for Veridian exec offsite
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@lighthouseevents.com>
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@veridianbank.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision brief: Meeting room selection + AV/interop checklist for Veridian exec offsite

Team —

We need a single-page decision and action list for the Veridian executive offsite on May 24-25. High level constraints: 60 total attendees, split 40 in main room, 20 remote (global locations), two breakout rooms, 1x30-minute all-hands panel with remote Q&A, and a requirement for recording + secure retention (Veridian compliance).

Options from Priya: 3rd-floor Auditorium (capacity 120, fixed stage, in-ceiling mics), and a Club Room A+B (split rooms, portable riser). My priorities:
- Single-room experience should degrade gracefully to hybrid bridge if primary vendor fails.
- Onstage mics + 8 lavs for panel + 6 wireless attendee mics for Q&A in main room.
- Dedicated RTMP+recording to Veridian S3 with encryption; retention 90 days.
- Interpreter headsets not required unless Veridian confirms.

Action items I want in this thread (owners in parens):
1) Confirm final room (Marissa) — if Auditorium, ensure breakout acoustic plan; if Club Room, confirm riser/vision lines.
2) AV spec and vendor scope (Rafael/SwitchBridge) — include show-stopping fallback sequence and explicit bandwidth/test windows.
3) Network / STUN/TURN + firewall rule list for Veridian (Jonas) — confirm on-site IPs and proxy settings.
4) Travel windows and VIP arrival + greenroom (Marissa) — include 1.5 hour rehearsal slot on May 23.

Priya — can you attach the Level 3 site plan and any load-in constraints? Rafael — can you draft a concise vendor scope and the quote by EOD Friday? Jonas — quick note on what minimum bandwidth we need for stable 1080p RTMP + 3 concurrent meeting rooms.

I’ll consolidate a one-page ops brief for procurement and Veridian by Friday noon.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Subject: Re: Decision brief: Meeting room selection + AV/interop checklist for Veridian exec offsite

Thanks Kim — attaching the Level 3 site plan and an AV spec matrix (high level).

Quick read:
- Auditorium pros: single focal point, dedicated in-ceiling mix, easier sight-lines for hybrid camera pods. Cons: fixed lighting grid could conflict with recording angles; breakout noise bleed possible.
- Club Room (A+B) pros: better breakout separation, flexible seating; cons: sight-line compromises and extra rigging for AV.

Operational notes:
- Load-in windows: May 23, 08:00–16:00. No overnight storage in the loading dock; trucks must vacate by 1700.
- Rehearsal: request 90 min on May 23 starting 16:30 (we should confirm with Priya).
- Greenroom: small suite on 2nd floor; needs bottled water and single A/V monitor for speaker notes.

I've added a short checklist to the AV spec matrix: mic counts, codec preferences (H.264 baseline for compatibility), RTMP target and bucket name placeholder, and power drop locations. Rafael — if SwitchBridge can confirm which camera package (2x PTZ + 1x 4K static) they propose, we can lock sight-lines.

Attachments: site_plan_level3.pdf, av_spec_matrix.xlsx

Marissa

Subject: Re: Decision brief: Meeting room selection + AV/interop checklist for Veridian exec offsite

Rafael here from SwitchBridge — thanks for the brief. Draft quote attached (switchbridge_quote_0426.pdf). Key clarifications and asks:

1) Fallback flow: Primary bridge (Zoom Enterprise) + failover to Redwood-hosted bridge (we can connect via SRT/RTMP). We recommend a hot standby encoder and a second uplink path.
2) Camera package proposed: 2x 4K PTZ (main/presenter), 1x static 4K for the far stage, plus 3x close-up pod PTZ for panel.
3) Mic plan: 8 lavs, 6 handhelds (switchable to audience), 2x desk condensers for panel.
4) Interpreter support: We can provide 16-channel IR headset system on request — needs 48 hours notice and power for the base station.
5) Recording: We will stream to the provided RTMP target and deliver a master MP4 + separate isolated track for the panel. Please confirm S3 credentials will be shared via secure transfer 48 hours before event.

Bandwidth estimate: 12–15 Mbps uplink dedicated for 1080p main stream + discrete 720p backup + redundant encoder heartbeat. If Veridian requires higher-quality multi-track recordings, add 5–8 Mbps.

We flagged a site constraint: the Auditorium ceiling grid has two suspended acoustic baffles near the stage (see attached plan). We recommend adding two elevated camera risers to clear sight-lines. Pricing in the attached is itemized with a fallback penalty reduction for multi-day bookings.

Let us know if you want us to include a cost line for interpreter headsets and for pre-show remote connectivity tests (we recommend two test windows: May 10 and May 20).

— Rafael Mendes
Head of Field Ops, SwitchBridge AV

Subject: Re: Decision brief: Meeting room selection + AV/interop checklist for Veridian exec offsite

Quick network and security notes from infra:

- Minimum dedicated uplink: 25 Mbps egress reserved for event (this gives headroom for multi-track and redundancy). We will provision a VLAN and firewall rules for SwitchBridge encoder IP(s); SwitchBridge should provide static IPs or use mTLS client auth.
- STUN/TURN not required if we're using RTMP/SRT to a public endpoint, but for the interactive Q&A bridge (WebRTC) we recommend TURN servers in us-west-2.
- For Veridian’s S3 ingestion: we will generate a time-limited PUT URL from the Veridian bucket. Rafael/ops: coordinate key exchange via our secure transfer (SFTP endpoint will be provided).
- Firewall rules to request from Veridian: outbound 1935/tcp (RTMP), 443/tcp to Redwood API endpoints, and UDP ranges for TURN (if used).
- Test windows: May 10 (1300–1500 PT) and May 20 (0900–1100 PT). We will confirm test accounts and a technical checklist by April 22.

I can manage the TURN recommendation and will circle back with the exact IPs by Monday. Also recommend we capture a short runbook with the failover trigger (e.g., if encoder heartbeat absent for >10s, switch RTMP to backup encoder).

Jonas

Appreciate the fast turn, everyone. Decisions and next steps: 

1) Room: Auditorium selected. Rationale: single focal UX for the panel and simpler camera choreography. Marissa — please confirm riser orders and elevated camera positions with Priya.
2) Vendor: SwitchBridge approved to proceed. Rafael — please issue a final PO and include interpreter headsets as an optional add-on (Veridian will confirm).
3) Network: Jonas to provide the exact IPs and TURN recommendation by EOD Monday. Confirmed test windows (May 10 & May 20).
4) Rehearsal: reserve 16:30–18:00 on May 23 as rehearsals; load-in May 23, 08:00–16:00.
5) Recording + retention: Rafael/ops to deliver master MP4 to Veridian S3 via the secure transfer; retention 90 days. Rafael — please confirm delivery SLA and encryption method.

Marissa — once Rafael sends the final PO I’ll route to procurement and to Alex for compliance sign-off. Priya/Alex — if there are any policy constraints on on-site vendors we should note now, flag them in this thread.

Goal: have signed PO + network runbook by April 22.

Kimberly
